purpose: Fresh-input confirmation of two preselected RECTANGLE SAC contrasts and assessment across eight new uniformly sampled 80-bit keys
design_disclosure: Targets were selected from the previously inspected discovery and size-matching results. The key list, input-seed recipe, analysis, calibration choices and multiplicity families are frozen before any main confirmation data are generated. Fresh inputs give independent confirmation conditional on the fixed trained calibration; the random-key sample is small and does not establish all-key behavior.
key_selection: Default key plus eight distinct PCG64 draws of ten bytes, interpreted as a big-endian 80-bit key. Reject a draw only for duplication with the default, another draw, or a historical eight-key study key. No key is selected by its performance. keys.json is frozen with the execution source.
query_budget: N*(64+1) trace inputs per replicate/sample size. N=256 is a nested prefix of N=1024; rounds share the same traces and all detectors receive identical count matrices.

seed_recipes.tests: Separate base_seed 991151 and/or stage 599; never inspect main-input outcomes in preflight tests

calibration: Reuse the complete frozen size-matching decision rules and three million-draw banks per N, unchanged across keys. No new fitting or null draws. Conditional held-out sizes and residual mismatch from the previous study still apply.
inference: Two-sided exact paired McNemar tests. Primary family: 2 preselected contrasts x 9 keys = 18 tests, bank 0 match_count_nonrandom, Holm FWER 0.05. All 6 conditions x 3 comparators x 9 keys = 162 contrasts also receive a separate full-grid Holm adjustment. Other policies/banks have separately labeled sensitivity families; no pooling across banks.
intervals: Pointwise Wilson 95% intervals for per-key detection rates and 10000 paired multinomial bootstrap draws for differences. They condition on one key and a trained calibration. A degenerate interval does not prove equivalence or probability exactly zero/one.
across_keys: Keep the fresh default control separate from eight random keys. Report per-key results, equal-key-weighted mean rates/effects, observed ranges, effect directions and number of keys passing each corrected comparison. Do not treat 4000 random-key input replicates as 4000 independently sampled keys; do not infer the fraction of all keys with a true property from significance counts.
freshness_checks: Regenerate the 512000 discovery bases from archived seeds. Check input hashes, within-key duplicate bases and exact base intersections with discovery. The check concerns bases, not all one-bit-neighbor query sets. Distinct key/input seeds are fixed before data generation.
archive: Per-key raw sufficient statistics, replicate/input-prefix hashes, global/row/column eight-bin histograms for every analyzed matrix, sums and squared sums of count matrices, and full native count-matrix snapshots at replicates 0,1,2,499. Retain source/key/calibration hashes and environment/elapsed metadata. Original measurements and production implementations remain unchanged.
reporting: Report all keys and grids, including failures, reversals and nonsignificant results. Default-control confirmation is evaluated independently of historical outcomes. Stability over calibration banks is sensitivity rather than new input replications. No early stopping, replacement keys or validation-guided choices.
limitations: Eight random keys give limited coverage of the 80-bit key space. Different keys use independent input samples, so observed cross-key variation includes finite-input variation. Calibration is reused, and size matching is conditional/approximate as documented previously. Analysis does not identify the cryptographic mechanism or establish a new contiguous horizon, full-round security claim, SAC-2 comparison or key-recovery attack. Word manuscript editing is outside this experiment.
